meta.design: Design 5 (generated by Claude as a recommendation): king bed, headboard on the window wall against the west wall; 3 m bracket wardrobe on the east wall; 600 vanity in the SE corner; study table on the west wall
meta.units: mm, plan coordinates (same as floor_plan.json: +x right, +y down the page)
meta.layout: Fixes the Design 4 issues: no bed under the window's full length, no pinch at the foot of the bed, a bed frame spec that fits. King divan bed (mattress-sized base) with the headboard on the window wall (<= 900, 150 gap for the blackout curtains), against the Bedroom 2 wall; east side 670 aisle (no bedside table), west sleeper gets in from the foot (floating wall shelf as bedside). East wall: open window corner, then a 3000 bracket-and-pole wardrobe (His north 1500: double hang + 2 baskets; Hers south 1500: 2 baskets + long hang) behind 4 pairs of free-sliding bi-folds parked at the south end; 600 x 600 vanity in the SE corner, mirror faces west (away from the bed). Study table 1090 x 600 on the west wall below the bed, monitor on the wall. Full-length mirror in the lobby (faces north, not the bed); bag hooks on the room's south wall. No TV. No mirror faces the bed.
meta.orientation: North = facade/window wall (top of plan). East = facade side wall (right). South = Bath/WC 1 wall with the WC door at x 11950-12650. West = Bedroom 2 wall; lobby + room door to the south-west.
meta.note: Product sizes are typical catalogue sizes; confirm before ordering. Bed must be a divan / platform no bigger than 1850 x 1930 plus an 80 mm headboard.

interior.note: Wall-face to wall-face, assuming 150 mm internal / 200 mm external walls: ~3125 W x 4250 L. Verify on site.

bed.size: King 1830 x 1910 (SG king 183 x 190 cm), divan base the same size as the mattress
bed.note: Headboard on the window wall, 900 high (= the sill), 150 gap behind it for the blackout curtains (window wall at y 100). Against the west (Bedroom 2) wall. Footprint 1830 x 1990 incl. the headboard.

bedsides.name: West wall shelf
bedsides.note: 150 deep floating shelf on the Bedroom 2 wall for the west sleeper (phone / glasses), just above the mattress

vanity.note: 600 W x 600 D floating top in the SE corner (east wall), mirror on the east wall facing west - towards the WC door / lobby, not the bed. Stool tucks under.

bracket_wardrobe.note: Not carpentry: 3000 long on the east wall (y 750-3750), ~600 deep, starting 650 from the window wall so it doesn't cover the glass. Wire shelf at 2050, upper pole at 1900 full length. His (north 1500): double hang 900 (lower pole 1000 + wire shelf 1150) + 2 pull-out baskets (600 W, at 540 / 750) under short hang. Hers (south 1500): 2 pull-out baskets (600 W) under short hang + long hang 900.

bifold.note: White free-sliding bi-folds, 4 pairs (~372 leaves) on one top track 625 from the wall. Park at the SOUTH end (stack ~340 long, sticks out ~370 into open floor beside the vanity). Parked north they would narrow the bed aisle to ~300.

l_desk.note: Study table 1090 x 600 on the west wall from the foot of the bed to the lobby; end panels, no cabinets below. 1 office chair.

monitor.note: PRISM+ X340 PRO on a VESA wall arm on the west wall above the study table, facing east.

hook_rail.note: Bag hooks on the room's south wall between the WC door and the vanity stool (swapped with the mirror).

mirrors.name: Full-length mirror
mirrors.note: Lobby's south wall, faces north (not the bed). Starts at x 11100 so the room door's swing clears it.

mbr_vanity.note: vanity in the SE corner (mirror faces west)

mbr_aisle.note: east aisle to the bedside / window

mbr_mirror.note: full-length mirror in the lobby (faces north, away from the bed)

mbr_hooks.note: bag hooks on the south wall
